name: Moto g56 HID + MediaProjection 100 ms qualification candidate

viewScroll.centerDisplayFollows: 04-Office drives CenterDisplayX from an OBJECT selected by `viewing`: `camera follow 2` at viewing=0 (office), `camera follow` on some cameras, hard 0 on viewing 1-4, 5 and 6. The pan is the display centre tracking a marker, not a player-dragged offset, so that marker's x is the state variable.
viewScroll.note: xCoef 1.00 (layer 0) means the control scrolls 1:1 with the view, so a FIXED screen coordinate for it is only valid at a known pan offset. The light hitboxes are layer 0; the flip mask button is layer 4 at xCoef 0.00 and does not move. monitorFrame is layer 3 at xCoef 1.00 -- but that is the FRAME, and the object list does not name the monitor toggle's own hitbox, so `monitor` is UNKNOWN(not-traced) rather than assumed to scroll with it. This is why a panned office loses light presses while mask presses still land -- the asymmetry measured on Night 3, 2026-09-19. NOTHING in the executor models pan state, so every entry marked true has a coordinate valid only at pan 0.
viewScroll.panObservation: UNKNOWN(not-implemented): the Cue Helper reports pan_anchor_state but read UNKNOWN (pan_anchor_reason=bulb-not-found) throughout the 2026-09-19 runs.
viewScroll.source: application.ccn 04-Office. Frame header chunk 13108 (world/window). Layers chunk 13121 read as 16.16 FIXED POINT -- a float read returns 0.000 for every layer and looks like a real answer. Instances chunk 13112: 4-byte count then 20-byte records handle/oi/x/y/parentType/parentHandle/layer/unknown, instance OI is raw ^48 then ^28 for build 26. Several hitboxes are REPOSITIONED at StartOfFrame, so a placed coordinate can lie: grep the frame for SetPosition.
viewScroll.ventLightNote: The two vent lights are 1297 px apart in world space inside a 1024 px window, on a layer that scrolls 1:1 across 576 px of pan. They therefore CANNOT both be correct at any single fixed screen coordinate -- the profile maps leftVentLight and rightVentLight to fixed points regardless.

camera follow 2.note: the office display centre tracks this object (viewing=0)

left light.note: lightLeftHitbox is SetPosition-attached to this at StartOfFrame

musicButtonHitbox.note: SetPosition to an ABSOLUTE (233,610) OR (233,595) chosen by a global value -- two valid positions 15 px apart, so a profile can be calibrated against the wrong one

right light.note: lightRightHitbox is SetPosition-attached to this at StartOfFrame
